# Documentation Concern

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DocumentationConcern`](gmeow-DocumentationConcern.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DocumentationConcern>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A cross-cutting documentation theme generated into its own guide page. Terms opt into a concern with [`gmeow:docsConcern`](../properties/gmeow-docsConcern.md) so adoption-oriented docs are ontology-backed, not a private renderer taxonomy.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:DocumentationConcern`](gmeow-DocumentationConcern.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare a cross-cutting documentation theme that terms from many slices opt into, so a generated guide page is backed by the graph rather than by a private renderer taxonomy.

### Avoid when

- Avoid creating a concern for a single slice's local narrative (that belongs in its docs.md guide) and avoid per-concern subclasses; concerns are individuals referenced by [`gmeow:docsConcern`](../properties/gmeow-docsConcern.md).

### How to use

- Mint the concern as an individual, then annotate participating terms with [`gmeow:docsConcern`](../properties/gmeow-docsConcern.md) pointing at it; the documentation generator collects them into one themed page.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:coarsenTo`](../properties/gmeow-coarsenTo.md) [`gmeow:docsConcern`](../properties/gmeow-docsConcern.md) [`gmeow:concernDisclosure`](../individuals/gmeow-concernDisclosure.md).
